Name: Pride Flags for Alternative Textures
Author: DGlaky
Description: Adds various pride flags using the Alternative Textures mod. All pride flags are textures for paintings similar in size to 'A Night At Eco-Hill'. Textures can be changed using the Paint Bucket item, which can be purchased for 500g from Robin's shop.
